name: MiraTurn
title: Mira Turn
description: A single message in a Mira conversation. User turns and agent turns are both stored. Personal health information is scrubbed server-side before persist: PHI-bearing user turns are stored with role='user' and content set to the literal '[redacted — personal health detail]' marker, so the conversation shape is preserved for context without retaining the sensitive text. See the miraAnswer function for the scrub.

session_id.description: MiraSession.id this turn belongs to. Indexed for fast session hydration.

session_key.description: Denormalized session_key for RLS. Matches the parent MiraSession.session_key; kept here so reads can be scoped without a join.

surface.description: Surface that originated this turn. Matches the parent session.

role.description: Who said this turn. 'user' for the person, 'agent' for Mira.

content.description: Turn text. Capped at 4000 chars to bound storage. User turns are capped and PHI-scrubbed before write.

posture.description: Posture Mira projected when emitting this turn (agent turns only). Stored for replay and audit.

live.description: Whether this turn was produced by a live model. False for recorded/replay fallback turns.

redacted.description: True if the original user content was replaced with a redaction marker because it matched a PHI pattern.
